$description: atlas-console · porcelain — machine-readable sibling of DIRECTION.md. Format: Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) format, pinned to the Community Group Draft of 30 July 2026. This is NOT a W3C Recommendation. Limits of this file, stated out loud: (1) dimension and duration values are objects, and the dimension unit set is closed to px and rem — therefore this is a WEB artifact; Apple pt and Material dp/sp are not expressible here (moot for this run: web-only, desktop-only, by recorded decision — DIRECTION.md §1/RISK 4). (2) The color value shape in this draft (hex string vs colorSpace+components object) was not confirmed against the primary source; hex strings are used and DIRECTION.md is authoritative for color until confirmed. (3) Paired color tokens are a convention this plugin imposes, not a DTCG type — pairs are modeled as sibling tokens whose $description carries the measured WCAG ratio (script-verified 2026-08-14; Loop 2 prototype-confirmed values marked). (4) DTCG has no theme/mode construct — 'light' and 'dark' are sibling groups; this run is one design in two palettes, with per-mode deltas named in DIRECTION.md. (5) bar-lo is Loop 2's recommended replacement for the approved chart gray (which measured 1.21:1, below the 3:1 non-text floor) — accepted at Gate B closure 2026-08-14 (see runs/atlas-console/SKIPS.md).

bg.$description: app substrate. Legal fg: ink 16.57 · ink2 4.814 (thin, script-confirmed) · acc 4.86

card.$description: raised surface. Legal fg: ink 17.74 · ink2 5.15 · acc 5.20 · ok-tx 5.37 · bad-tx 6.16 · warn-tx 5.09

ink.$description: text-primary + primary-button fill; #ffffff on it 17.74. The ONLY text color legal directly on the glass palette (worst-case rendered 8.02 — TESTED)

ink2.$description: text-secondary; 4.814 on bg (thin margin, no headroom), 5.15 on card. NEVER directly on glass (worst-case rendered 3.98 — fails 4.5; opaque backing or ink substitution required). Disabled = ink2 at 55% opacity, contrast-exempt, never the only disabled signal

line.$description: hairline, DECORATIVE ONLY (1.21 vs card) — never the sole boundary/state signal, and per T3 never a data-carrying bar fill

acc.$description: the one accent: links, active nav, focus ring (4.86 vs bg, floor 3.0), filter chips, sparkline stroke (5.20 vs card, floor 3.0; rendered-pixel confirmed). Never a data color, never a text-on-accent fill

acc-t.$description: accent tint: active nav fill, selected row, filter chip. acc on it 4.580 (thin, no headroom); ink on it 15.62 (script-confirmed, replaces hand ≈15.7)

ok-tx.$description: pair of ok-bg; 5.37 on card (delta arrows)

warn-bg.$description: pair: warn-tx on warn-bg = 4.542 (thin, no headroom — any tint change re-runs the contrast script)

warn-tx.$description: ADJUSTED from approved #96660f (was 4.46, below floor) — one 0.005 OKLCH L step, hue/chroma held; logged in DIRECTION.md §3; rendered-pixel confirmed in T5

bar-lo.$description: ACCEPTED at Gate B 2026-08-14: chart data-gray, 3.0002 vs card — boundary value, zero headroom; #939499 (3.027) is the headroom alternative. Replaces line-token bars (1.21, fails 3:1 non-text). oklch(66.9% 0.007 275)

btn-ink.$description: primary button fill (= ink in light)

scrim.$description: modal scrim, ink at 32% — modal dialogs only; the glass palette floats WITHOUT a page scrim, as approved

surface-hover.$description: chip button / secondary control hover fill

card.$description: Legal fg: ink 14.68 · ink2 6.23 · acc 7.34 · ok-tx 9.76 · warn-tx 8.98 · bad-tx 7.37

ink.$description: text-primary; also dark primary-button fill (inverted), #17181c on it 15.33. The ONLY text color legal directly on glass (worst-case rendered 5.00 — TESTED)

ink2.$description: NEVER directly on glass (worst-case rendered 4.59 — thin; rule kept mode-symmetric with light's hard fail)

line.$description: hairline, DECORATIVE ONLY (1.22 vs card); never a data-bar fill

acc.$description: focus ring 7.95 vs bg; sparkline 7.34 vs card (rendered-pixel confirmed); on acc-t 6.46

bar-lo.$description: ACCEPTED at Gate B 2026-08-14: chart data-gray, 3.0081 vs card — boundary value, zero headroom. oklch(51.3% 0.007 275)

btn-ink.$description: primary button fill, inverted in dark

scrim.$description: modal scrim, black at 48% — dark needs more scrim to separate card from bg

space.$description: base unit 8px with 4px half-steps, as in the approved frames. Steps listed each have a named job; absent steps are information, not omissions.

4.$description: kbd-chip gap, dot-label gap (5px is the one odd value, kept as approved)

8.$description: th padding-y, compact td padding-y, filter-chip gap, control icon gap

10.$description: nav-row pad-x, cell pad-x, palette pad, user-card pad, control gap

12.$description: sidebar pad-x, searchfield pad-x, palette row pad-x

14.$description: chipbtn pad-x, panel-head margin-bottom, bar-group gap

16.$description: grid gap (stats, panels), sidebar pad-y, inkbtn pad-x, stat pad-y

28.$description: main region pad-y (caps here — margins stop growing past desktop, declared as this run's own ladder)

radius.$description: concentric rule in use: inner = outer − gap. kbd chip r6 = palette r16 − pad 10 (the register already obeys it). Palette rows keep the approved r10 (an interaction highlight, not a nested container — recorded deviation).

sans.$description: self-hosted; repo latin variable woff2 = 48,256 B on disk (TESTED)

mono.$description: NOT yet in repo — vendoring is a build task; subset to caps+digits+symbols (mono roles use no lowercase); if subset exceeds 18KB it moves to tier 2 with the ui-monospace stack painting first (contingency pre-decided, DIRECTION.md budgets)

size.$description: role-indexed scale (not a ratio) — roles named in DIRECTION.md §5 with rem equivalents and line heights

stat.$description: T4 finding: the <small> unit suffix must not sit on flex-baseline or the row inflates to 37px — build note in DIRECTION.md

phead.$description: panel-head line-height pinned (T3: deterministic baseline insurance)

motion.$description: porcelain moves rarely, briefly, without bounce: no springs, no stagger (stagger 0ms by decision), exit < enter, nothing animates in above the fold, backdrop-filter is never animated. Reduced-motion states are art-directed per technique — DIRECTION.md motion spec.

micro.$description: hover/active fills, focus ring, pill/chip state

swap.$description: skeleton→content opacity crossfade, no movement; CLS measured 0 (T4)

shimmer.$description: skeleton shimmer loop, compositor-only (throttle-invariance proven, T4), motion-allowed only

micro.$description: reduced motion: transform removed; opacity/color fades ≤120ms retained

overlay-enter.$description: opacity 0→1 + scale(0.98)→1, transform-origin top center; backdrop-filter constant from first frame. Reduced motion: instant fully-opaque panel (designed state, built + screenshotted in T1)

swap.$description: skeleton→content; reduced motion: static blocks, no shimmer, swap still fades (opacity only)

shadow.$description: elevation has 3 resting levels (0 flush · 1 card/panel · 2 floating overlay); drawn as border(1px line) + shadow together; light direction identical in both modes, spread retuned per mode — DIRECTION.md elevation row

overlay.$description: as approved: same overlay shadow both modes
